provenance_note: Expected values recorded from an independently authored corpus written from SPEC-h2-co2-pipeline-repurposing.md without the page code; this run executes the shipping build against them and re-derives nothing.
reference: Hand-designed corpus written from SPEC-h2-co2-pipeline-repurposing.md rev 2026-10-17.6 (model 2026-10-11.hc-4, unchanged in rev .5; including the section 13.11 corrections) alone; 346 cases: 254 from rev .3 re-derived, 70 for the impure-CO2 screen of SPEC 13 (rev .4) and 22 for the hydrogen bubble-side band of SPEC 13.6-13.7 (rev .5, group h2-band). Expected values from an independent implementation: ref_impl.py (standard library; Span-Wagner derivative derived by hand, root search as in SPEC section 4) and ref_mixture.py (SPEC 13: residual Helmholtz energy of teqp 0.23.2 'multifluid' with the fluiddata/dev files named in SPEC 13.2, chemical potentials with the composition derivative of R removed as SPEC 13.3 states; density scan, saturation Newton system, Wilson start, continuation, central-difference extremum search, crossing bisections, monotone-branch density scans, stable single-phase root and bubble-side band b_bub written from SPEC 13.3-13.7 and 13.11). Second route (verify.py, verify_mixture.py): mpmath Span-Wagner with numerical delta-derivative and CoolProp root bracketing for pure CO2; for mixtures CoolProp 8.0.0 HEOS (NORMALIZE_GAS_CONSTANTS false) densities, dew/bubble/cricondentherm/cricondenbar roots re-solved with MINPACK from perturbed starts, reducing density from teqp's own reducing functions, phase labels checked by a Michelsen tangent-plane stability test, and the selection / check / gap / action logic re-implemented separately. The envelope topology (which crossings exist, crit step, open/closed trace) of the second route is taken from the reference trace, so it is checked only through the stability test.

tolerance: Numbers: |a - e| <= 1e-9 * |e| (purely relative; an expected 0 requires exactly 0). In a case screened by SPEC 13 (expected phase with model 'multifluid'): |a - e| <= 1e-6 * |e| for the numbers inside phase and for the value of the checks phase and phase_margin (SPEC 10 and 13.9). Why 1e-6 there: the mixture numbers are roots of a Newton system with a central-difference Jacobian and bisections on an envelope trace, and SPEC 13.9 states 1e-6 as the reproducibility of an independent implementation; the reference and the CoolProp route agree to 1.3e-12 (dew/bubble) and 1e-14 (density), so 1e-6 is the SPEC's contract, not a measured scatter. Every SPEC 13 case keeps its decisions clear of that tolerance: corner and window temperatures > 0.5 K from a crit step and from T_cdt, P > 1e-6 relative from c1/c2, from the band edges 0.03 c1 and b_bub c2 and, in co2dense with H2, (P - p_ref)/p_ref > 1e-6 from b_bub (band cases at 1e-4 relative), rho > 1e-6 relative from rho_r and from dense_min_density. Objects are compared over the keys given in expected; arrays element by element with equal length; strings, booleans and null exactly. Cases with restore_replaces: true omit warnings (restored_values is not part of the corpus).

Span-Wagner states within 1e-9 (absolute, in |P - p_sat|/p_sat) of the 0.5 % band edge or within 1e-7 of p_sat, within 1e-6 relative of rho_c (co2gas supercritical), within 1e-7 relative of dense_min_density, within 0.01 K of T_c or 1e-6 K of T_tr (except the flagged exact T_c / T_tr cases, which form T as the binary64 sum t + 273.15 written in SPEC section 4; a comparison made in degrees Celsius gives the opposite result there)

States where SPEC root search and the true largest/smallest root could differ (T within ~1e-4 K below T_c, a scan step jumping a van der Waals loop); P exactly equal to p(rho) at a search step, or within 1e-6 relative of p at the liquid-scan floor (1.0497e-3 kg/m3)

phase_margin value equal to phase_margin_min except the two exactly representable cases (1 MPa above p_c, P = p_c); co2gas P equal to p(rho_c, T) (margin 0 and rho = rho_c both decided by rounding; +/-1e-3 tested)
Exact equality of k_ratio and k_ratio_max (irrational K; only +/-1e-7 relative margins are tested)

manifest.note: Manifest v2 accepted by catalog.php under transients with only the tool count changed; no project-package register is declared; the node lives in workflow-map.json without edges until the re-anchoring pass that closes Tools 15–19.

localisation.note: Opened in en, uk, de, nl, fr, es and pl: no undefined/NaN/[object Object] rendered, no console errors; the default study and every example are built in the reader's language.

mobile_desktop.note: Rendered at 390, 768, 769 and 1440 px in all seven languages with every example and no root horizontal overflow; only the inputs and evidence of the selected mode are shown.

permalink_round_trip.note: Each of the seven examples opened from its permalink in a fresh page reproduces the state and every record output; a restored state passes through the vocabulary and number checks.

presets.note: Seven editable synthetic examples: known steel in hydrogen (hoop 244.9 MPa, 0.684 of SMYS, K/K_env 0.32, hardness 220 against 250 HV, all checks confirmed), the same pipe in gaseous CO₂ (liquid-like at 7 MPa and 5 °C, 926 kg/m³ by Span–Wagner, 3.03 MPa above saturation: phase and margin rejected), a hydrogen blend with fatigue open (K/K_env 0.50), dense-phase CO₂ in a 508 × 15.9 mm line (0.644 of SMYS; 603.2 kg/m³ at 11 MPa and 45 °C against a 600 kg/m³ floor, 3.62 MPa above the critical pressure: met), CO₂ with unknown impurities (phase and water open), and the Learn try and fix cases.

learn_mode.note: Topics and tour include the try / explanation / correction case: with an unidentified weld and no defect data the crack screen stays open although K is 0.32 of the toughness; with the weld identified and inspected every check is confirmed.

report_all_languages.note: Report generated in seven languages, 4 pages each with the mode plot, footer URL on every page, no untranslated or repeated sentence, no console error.

python_export.note: Exported script runs on the standard library, including the Span–Wagner equation and its fixed scan and bisection; self-test reproduces 61 values of the default study within 1e-9 relative; the two decision outputs are named as not reproduced.
